newsitem.title: UK: Railtrack up after agreement with OFRAIL.
newsitem.headline: Railtrack up after agreement with OFRAIL.

text.p: Shares in Railtrack Plc rose on Friday as the market hailed the rail infrastructure operator's agreement with the industry's regulator OFRAIL to make the company more accountable.
By 0830 GMT the stock was up 11-1/2p to 617p.
"The market is relieved that they settled the rift with the regulator", one trader said.
Rail regulator John Swift said on Thursday that he had agreed with Railtrack on a mutually-agreed licence amendment on making Railtrack publicly accountable for its network management plans.
The rail operator has been criticised recently for its investment performance.
Apart from that, Railtrack could be less hard hit by the Labour government's windfall tax on privatised utilities.
"If the tax is based more on profits than on the shares performance than Railtrack would be better off", one analyst said.
The Financial Times newspaper said on Friday using a formula related to profits rather than returns would also less attract legal challenges.
